title: Iron Man 3 REBUILT 2.1.0
summary: New armors, restored content, offline features, and improvements to Iron Man 3.
changelog: — REBUILT 2.1.0 —
RESTORED FEATURES
Restored armor descriptions through the dropdown panel on the armor selection screen.
Restored the in-run sidebar, loading screen tips, and pre-run bonus purchase screen.
PRE-RUN BONUSES
Stark Credit Booster doubles Stark Credits earned during the run.
Alpha Multiplier multiplies the final score by four.
Proton Field protects against the first three hits.
Bonuses apply only to the current run and are disabled during the tutorial.
Removed store access during bonus selection to prevent conflicts and crashes.
Fixed bonus purchases, displayed prices, icons, and effect handling.
ARMOR SELECTION
Improved the layout of armor names, descriptions, and score multipliers.
Restored the original decorative line on the left side.
The Special panel now displays the armor's ability icon.
Added the Repulsor Overcharge icon to Weapon Damage and retained the reactor icon for Hit Points.
Improved icon sizes and alignment, including the Unibeam icon.
Added Proton Shield and AA Defense category icons with a gradual fade toward the right.
Added and updated descriptions for REBUILT armors.
PROGRESSION AND BALANCING
Fixed armor prerequisites to follow the order within each category.
Corrected prerequisites that required completing an armor instead of unlocking it.
Blue Steel requires all other armors to be unlocked; Igor requires Gamma.
Moved the final armor unlock message from Igor to Blue Steel.
The 15,000 ISO-8 Unlock All Armors purchase now includes REBUILT armors.
The Unlock All Armors trophy now checks all 42 armors.
Revised numerous research, construction, and upgrade costs.
MASTERY CHALLENGES
Fixed challenge progression for added armors.
Rebalanced objectives using original armors with similar score multipliers as references.
Removed duplicate Weapon Damage and Hit Points objectives.
Removed kill objectives involving defensive abilities such as Proton Shield and AA Defense.
Corrected objective assignments across the three attributes.
WOODLANDS
Fixed the cropped store thumbnail using the complete image from version 1.4.0.
Fixed ISO-8 unlock persistence after restarting the game. The normal level 12 requirement is unchanged.
Fixed the post-run store displaying Santa Monica's image instead of Woodlands.
Restored forest ambience in the non-snowy Woodlands.
Fixed distant mountains disappearing when moving from the forest into the city in both Woodlands variants.
HUD AND ARMOR EFFECTS
Removed the Unibeam icon incorrectly shown on the charge meter for every special ability.
Corrected Mark 26 Gamma's hand repulsor effects to match Mark 25, removing unwanted hand flames.
COMMUNITY
Fixed tournament invitations displaying UI_FACEBOOK_invite_friend instead of the invitation text.
Restored the original invitation message and added the official REBUILT Discord link.
Replaced the game rating prompt with an invitation to the official REBUILT Discord server.
The confirmation button now opens the Discord server directly.
Localized both community messages across all 12 supported languages.
ISO-8 STORE
Removed the nonfunctional Restore Purchases option.
LOCALIZATION
Corrected added armor names according to each language's original naming conventions.
Preserved original armor nicknames in Italian with the Serie prefix.
Updated pre-run bonus translations, including Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.
Localized ISO-8 store claim buttons.
Updated the tip explaining Blue Steel's unlock requirement.
STABILITY AND VERSION
Fixed movement and score progression becoming stuck during the tutorial.
Fixed several crashes and conflicts involving pre-run bonuses, the pause menu, and the store.
Fixed loading tips disappearing at the end of loading.
Updated the version displayed in the in-game credits and in the APK to 2.1.0.
── REBUILT 2.0.1 ──
Fixed a startup crash when an armor finished building while the game was closed.
Fixed armor slots so all 42 armors can be purchased.
Fixed overlapping armor models in the armor selection screens.
Customer Care buttons now open the Iron Man 3 REBUILT Discord server.
Added a mandatory update check at startup.
── REBUILT 2.0 ──
Added a brand-new set of armors!
MARK 30 - Blue Steel: Unibeam with a 10.0x score multiplier.
MARK 26 - Gamma: Proton Shield with an 8.0x score multiplier.
MARK 23 - Shades: Frost Charge with an 8.5x score multiplier.
MARK 21 - Midas: AA Defense with a 9.0x score multiplier.
MARK VIII: Striker Missile with a 6.5x score multiplier.
MARK IX: Unibeam with a 5.0x score multiplier.
MARK XIV: Frost Charge with a 5.0x score multiplier.
MARK XII: Proton Shield with a 7.5x score multiplier.
MARK X: AA Defense with a 7.5x score multiplier.
MARK XI: AA Defense with an 8.0x score multiplier.
Removed armors slot feature, you start the game with 42 slots unlocked
Renamed the snowy Woodlands map to Woodlands Holiday Special.
Re-added the original Woodlands map.
Restored the original ISO-8 store. Claim ISO-8 packs for free!
Added 50 offline friends with different scores. Challenge their records!
Restored tournaments with simulated opponents and weekly ISO-8 and Stark Credit rewards.
Added Change Aspect Ratio to the settings. Choose between 16:9 and 21:9. Restart the game to apply the change.
Tap the green Gameloft icon in the upper-right corner to check for updates and read the latest patch notes.
Bypassed license verification.
Fixed crashes when connected to the Internet.
Improved automatic screen rotation on supported devices.
Fixed crashes during age verification on certain devices.
Unlocked 60 FPS and enabled ultra-high graphics quality and special effects.
Adjusted unlock prices and requirements for selected armors. All 32 original armors can be unlocked.
Restored the armor repair feature from previous versions of the game.
Restored voice packs removed in previous versions of the game.
Improved texture quality for selected armors and environments.
Improved snowy terrain rendering in Woodlands Holiday Special.
Fixed rendering issues in selected environments.
Fixed texture rendering issues affecting selected armors.
Organized armors by their special weapon types.
Improved aspect-ratio handling and image centering on supported devices.
Added automatic notch detection on supported devices.
Removed the New label from Dunes in the location shop.
Improved text quality across supported languages.
Fixed installation conflicts with other Gameloft games.
Removed the Marvel logo video shown at startup.
Removed the OBB dependency. All game data is now included in the APK.
